atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Fast PNG encoding of plan images Hypothesis

The images a plan makes before its first frame (mask images, recolored images, image casters, opaque silhouettes) were encoded with tiny-skia's default deflate; the moving rasters' fast encoder (`fdeflate`, `png()`) makes the same pixels in a fraction of the time.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** one encoder for every plan image. **Allowed:** `plan.rs` doc, `plan/mask.rs`, `plan/recolor.rs`, `plan/shadow.rs` encode calls. **Forbidden:** raster sizes, render changes.
